levels.name: Hidden Single
levels.hint: Look at one row, column or box. Is there only ONE cell left where a number can go?

levels.name: Naked Single
levels.hint: Look at one empty cell. Its row, column and box already use 3 numbers - the 4th one goes here!

levels.name: Center Marks
levels.hint: When a cell's row, column and box already use 2 numbers, mark the 2 numbers left in the center. Cross one out when it appears in that row, column or box!

levels.name: Snyder Notation
levels.hint: A small number in a corner means: inside this box, that number is in one of the corner-marked cells.

levels.name: Pointing Pairs
levels.hint: If a box's corner marks for a number sit in one line, that number is zapped from the rest of that line.

levels.name: Naked Pair
levels.hint: Two cells in a row, column or box with the SAME two center marks own those numbers. Nobody else there can use them.

levels.name: Jigsaw Sudoku
levels.hint: The boxes are funny shapes! Each thick-outlined shape still needs 1, 2, 3 and 4.

levels.name: Anti-Knight Sudoku
levels.hint: Normal rules, PLUS: the same number can never be a chess knight's jump apart (2 one way, 1 the other).

levels.name: X-Wing (Optional)
levels.hint: Optional boss move! Works in rows OR columns: if a number fits in only 2 cells across 2 rows (lined up in 2 columns), zap it from the rest of those columns - or 2 columns zapping 2 rows!

levels.name: All-Star Challenge
levels.hint: 60 puzzles of increasing difficulty mixing every technique! The final 12 puzzles at the end require an X-Wing (marked with a warning symbol).
